title: What happened in AI — Jul 24, 2026
intro: Kimi K3's launch is still the story: it's drawing a US allegation that Moonshot AI stole from Anthropic's model, a scramble from NVIDIA and Microsoft to back rival open models, and a report that Kimi K3 agents autonomously found Redis zero-days and built a working RCE exploit.

Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5 with same-day AWS availability, and four independent Show HN launches converged on the same gap: unified control and eval-driven tooling for the coding agents builders already run.
highlights: Kimi K3's launch triggered a US allegation that Moonshot AI stole from Anthropic's model, plus a NVIDIA/Microsoft push toward rival open weights.
Researchers say Kimi K3 agents autonomously found Redis zero-days and built a working RCE exploit — no human exploit-writing involved.
Chip markets split on the fallout: Micron gets a bull case from cheaper-inference demand while analysts warn not to overread the semiconductor selloff.
Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5, its most capable Opus yet, live on AWS Bedrock at launch.
Four Show HN launches today all target the same gap: eval-driven skills, safe agent-run monorepos, and mission-control dashboards for coding agents.

categories.name: Kimi K3 Upends the Open-Model Race
categories.summary: Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 launch triggered a rapid Western response — NVIDIA and Microsoft rallying behind open models, the US alleging the model was built on stolen Anthropic material, and researchers showing Kimi K3 agents can autonomously find and exploit zero-days.

articles.title: What is China’s Kimi K3 and why is the US so rattled by it? - CNN
articles.summary: Kimi K3's benchmark parity with top US frontier models at a fraction of the reported training cost is what's driving the alarm in Washington.

articles.title: NVIDIA, Microsoft Lead Push for Open AI Models After Kimi K3 Launch - Yahoo! Finance Canada
articles.summary: Both companies are moving to back open-weight alternatives so Kimi K3 doesn't become the default option for cost-sensitive enterprise deployments.

articles.title: Kimi K3 Agents Found Redis Zero-Days and Built RCE Exploit, Researchers Say - The Hacker News
articles.summary: Researchers report the agents identified previously unknown Redis vulnerabilities and chained them into a working remote-code-execution exploit — a preview of AI-driven offensive security.

articles.title: China's Moonshot AI 'stole' from Anthropic's LLM model, alleges US - The Times of India
articles.summary: US officials claim Kimi K3 was trained using improperly obtained Anthropic model material, escalating the dispute over frontier-model provenance.

categories.name: Markets and Policy Brace for the Open-Weight Shock
categories.summary: Kimi K3's arrival is rippling through chip stocks and policy circles, with analysts split on whether the semiconductor selloff is overdone and the UK weighing what the model plus recent open-weight incidents mean for its own AI strategy.

articles.title: Micron Is A Strong Buy Again Because Of Kimi K3 - Seeking Alpha
articles.summary: The bull case: cheaper, capable open models increase inference volume and memory demand even as they undercut proprietary model pricing.

articles.title: 'Nvidia is digging its own grave': DeepSeek CEO backs China's AI chip push - WION
articles.summary: The DeepSeek CEO argues Nvidia's export restrictions accelerated China's push toward self-sufficient AI chips, pointing to Kimi K3 as evidence the strategy is working.

articles.title: Don’t Fall for the Semiconductor Selloff - Brownstone Research
articles.summary: The piece cautions investors against reading Kimi K3's efficiency gains as a demand collapse for AI chips, arguing inference volume still scales with model adoption.

articles.title: What the UK should learn from Kimi K3, WAICO and the Hugging Face incident - Wired-Gov
articles.summary: The piece argues the UK needs a clearer sovereign-AI stance given how quickly open-weight models and infrastructure incidents abroad can reshape the competitive and security landscape.

categories.name: New Frontier Models: Claude Opus 5 and FLUX 3
categories.summary: Anthropic shipped Claude Opus 5 with same-day AWS Bedrock availability, and Black Forest Labs released FLUX 3, a multimodal flow model the company says beats Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni, and Grok Imagine.

articles.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5
articles.summary: Anthropic's new top-tier Opus model targets long-running agents and professional coding work, positioned as a step change over the prior tier.

articles.title: Introducing Claude Opus 5 on AWS: Anthropic’s most capable Opus model
articles.summary: Opus 5 is available on Amazon Bedrock at launch, with AWS guidance for integrating it into agentic and production inference workloads.

articles.title: [AINews] Black Forest Labs FLUX 3 - Multimodal Flow Models that beat Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni and Grok Imagine, and FLUX-mimic video-action robotics model
articles.summary: FLUX 3 pairs image/video generation the company claims outperforms Seedance 2.0, Gemini Omni, and Grok Imagine with a new FLUX-mimic video-action robotics model.

articles.title: Claude models explained: choosing the best model for your use case | Claude by Anthropic
articles.summary: Anthropic's own guidance on picking a model class by cost-per-task vs. cost-per-token and building evals to settle the choice — timely with a new Opus tier now on the table.

categories.name: Coding Agents Builders Are Shipping
categories.summary: Four independent Show HN launches today point to the same gap: builders want eval-driven skill libraries, safe agent-run monorepos, and unified control surfaces for the coding agents they already run.

articles.title: Show HN: An AI agent skill repo built around evals, not demos
articles.summary: A skill repository structured around evaluation rather than demo prompts, aimed at making agent skills verifiable rather than just illustrative.

articles.title: Show HN: A monorepo where AI agents can safely build and maintain applications
articles.summary: A monorepo template meant to let AI agents build and ship production applications without the guardrails-free setups most templates assume.

articles.title: Show HN: Bohay – Mission control for your AI coding agents
articles.summary: A dashboard for tracking and directing multiple coding agents running in parallel, addressing the coordination gap as agent fan-out becomes common.

articles.title: Show HN: CLI Coding Agent that runs on llamafile and/or GGUF
articles.summary: A coding agent designed to run fully local against llamafile or GGUF-quantized models, for builders who don't want a hosted-API dependency.

categories.name: Inference, Cloud, and Data Infrastructure
categories.summary: Infrastructure news ranged from vLLM's early support for NVIDIA's next-gen Vera Rubin hardware to sovereignty concerns reshaping enterprise cloud tenders and national AI strategy.

articles.title: vLLM Runs on NVIDIA Vera Rubin Hardware
articles.summary: vLLM now runs end-to-end on pre-release Vera Rubin hardware, giving inference teams an early look at performance on NVIDIA's next GPU generation.

articles.title: Airbus Makes Protection from Extraterritorial Law a Scored Criterion in Its Cloud Tender
articles.summary: Airbus picked Scaleway as its sovereign cloud provider after scoring bids on protection from non-European extraterritorial law, not just technical capability.

articles.title: Presentation: Autonomous Data Products for the Autonomous Era: Rethinking Data Architecture for GenAI
articles.summary: The talk frames autonomous data products as containers that encapsulate pipelines and schemas, aimed at taming the data-management complexity behind production GenAI systems.

articles.title: Build an explainable next-best-product recommendation system for banking on AWS
articles.summary: A reference architecture for an explainable banking recommendation system using a multi-tower neural network with learned attention on SageMaker AI and PyTorch.

articles.title: At AI Summit, South Korea Outlines Its AI Future With NVIDIA and Partners
articles.summary: South Korea's president and business leaders met with NVIDIA and partners at the AI Summit to chart national AI infrastructure plans.
